BrochureContent.Content: DNG Thornton Properties are delighted to introduce Finsóige to the market. Set on approximately 0.5 acres of beautifully maintained grounds, this impressive detached family home extends to approximately 222 sq.m. (2,390 sq.ft.). Thoughtfully maintained, the property provides bright, spacious accommodation ideally suited to modern family living. At the heart of the home is the beautifully appointed kitchen/dining room, featuring a central island, refurbished lavender Eco AGA, and ample space for family dining and entertaining. The accommodation is both versatile and generous, comprising of a reception room, five bedrooms, two en-suite shower rooms, a family bathroom, and a range of flexible attic spaces.Attached to the house are a substantial garage and workshop, providing exceptional storage, workspace, and versatility for a range of uses. Ideal for those with hobbies, DIY interests, a home business, or requiring additional space for tools and equipment, these valuable areas offer practical benefits rarely found in modern homes. To the front, a large driveway provides ample off-street parking for multiple vehicles.The mature gardens have been lovingly cared for and provide an attractive outdoor setting, complete with a feature pond and generous lawned areas.Roundwood is widely regarded as one of Wicklow's most charming villages, offering a wonderful community atmosphere along with cafés, shops, schools, and an excellent range of local amenities. The village enjoys a peaceful yet vibrant setting and has become increasingly popular with families, outdoor enthusiasts, and those seeking a relaxed lifestyle within easy reach of Dublin. Surrounded by the breathtaking scenery of the Wicklow Mountains and within close proximity to Glendalough, residents can enjoy endless opportunities for walking, cycling, and outdoor pursuits. Excellent road connections via the N11 and surrounding routes ensure convenient access to Dublin City and neighbouring towns, making Roundwood a highly desirable residential location.

Entrance Hall - 6.06m x 8.29m
This spacious and welcoming entrance hall features a wooden staircase and tiled flooring. The space provides access to all principal ground-floor accommodation. Neutral décor and abundant natural light combine to create a bright and inviting first impression.

Living Room - 6.07m x 5.50m
This impressive dual-aspect living room is a superb reception space, flooded with natural light from three large windows fitted with plantation shutters. Pine flooring complements the room beautifully, while a feature wood-burning stove set within an attractive fireplace, complete with a solid oak mantel, creates a cosy focal point. Offering excellent proportions and a bright atmosphere, the room provides ample space for both family living and entertaining.

Kitchen/Dining Room - 3.63m x 8.29m
This beautifully appointed kitchen/dining room combines character and practicality, featuring a mix of tiled and pine flooring, together with an attractive central island incorporating a Beko oven. A striking lavender refurbished Eco AGA serves as a focal point, offering the charm of a traditional range cooker with the benefit of improved energy efficiency and reduced running costs. The kitchen is fitted with an excellent range of wall and base units, complemented by granite work surfaces, a Belfast-style sink, and a decorative tiled splashback. Large windows and sliding doors provide pleasant views over the garden and flood the space with natural light, while the dining area offers ample space for a family dining suite.

Utility Room - 3.26m x 1.81m
Conveniently located off the kitchen, the utility room provides additional workspace and storage, featuring tiled flooring, ample countertop space, and space for a washing machine and tumble dryer. The room also benefits from direct access to the rear garden.

Bedroom 1 - 3.63m x 3.14m
A bright and well-proportioned double bedroom featuring wood-effect linoleum flooring and a large window overlooking the garden. The room benefits from built-in wardrobes, providing excellent storage. Further enhancing its appeal is a private en-suite.

En-suite - 2.21m x 2.15m
This bright en-suite is fitted with a tiled shower enclosure incorporating a Triton electric shower, together with a wash hand basin and WC.

Bedroom 2 - 4.79m x 5.21m
This double bedroom enjoys a bright and airy feel, enhanced by a large window and wood-effect linoleum flooring. Generously proportioned, the room provides ample space for a range of furnishings and is further complemented by a en-suite.

En-suite - 0.75m x 1.97m
Comprising a tiled en-suite with Triton electric shower, WC, and wash hand basin.

Bedroom 3 - 3.33m x 3.24m
A well-proportioned double bedroom featuring wood-effect linoleum flooring and a large window that allows natural light to flow into the room. Offering ample space for bedroom furniture, this comfortable room enjoys a pleasant outlook and is well suited to a variety of needs.

Bedroom 4 - 3.33m x 3.09m
A bright and versatile bedroom benefiting from a large window fitted with plantation shutters. The room offers ample space for bedroom furniture and could also serve as an ideal home office, study, or snug to suit a variety of needs.

Shower Room - 2.21m x 2.15m
A beautifully presented and fully tiled bathroom featuring a generous walk-in shower with rainfall shower head, wash hand basin set within a vanity unit, and WC. Finished to a high standard, the room also benefits from a frosted window providing natural light and ventilation.

Attic Room 1 - 6.07m x 3.64m
An impressive and generously proportioned attic space enjoying an abundance of natural light from a Velux window and front-facing window. Offering exceptional space and carpet flooring, the room also benefits from a spacious walk-in wardrobe, providing excellent storage.

Attic Room 2 - 2.57m x 1.89m
Fully tiled shower room featuring a Velux window, shower, WC, and wash hand basin. The Velux window allows an abundance of natural light to flow into the room

Attic Room 3 - 2.71m x 3.36m
Attic space featuring a Velux roof window and carpet flooring, currently utilised as a home office and dressing room. This versatile room offers excellent flexibility and could also serve as a study, hobby room, or additional storage space.

Spacious attic room featuring a Velux roof window and carpet flooring, currently utilised as a home office and bedroom. This bright space offers a range of potential uses, including a guest bedroom, study, or additional living accommodation.
